title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: Petroleu Privacy Policy — Learn how Digital Softs collects, uses, stores, and protects data in Petroleu petrol pump management software, website, web app, desktop app, and mobile applications.
content: This Privacy Policy explains how Digital Softs collects, uses, stores, protects, and manages information when customers, users, employees, or authorized staff access or use Petroleu, our petrol pump and fuel station management software.

id: Petroleu is a business software product developed, managed, and provided by Digital Softs. The software is available through our official website and domain petroleu.com, along with related web application, desktop application, and mobile application services. Petroleu is designed to help petrol pump owners, fuel station operators, managers, accountants, and authorized staff manage their daily business operations more efficiently.

Through Petroleu, users may manage fuel sales, nozzle readings, tank records, stock and inventory, purchases, credit sales, customer accounts, supplier accounts, expenses, reports, user roles, and other business-related data. Because the software may store important business and operational information, Digital Softs is committed to protecting user data and handling it responsibly.

This Privacy Policy describes what type of information we may collect, why we collect it, how we use it, how long we keep it, when we may share it, and what choices or rights users may have regarding their personal and business data. It also explains how we protect account information, login details, business records, technical logs, support inquiries, and data stored through our website, web app, desktop app, or mobile app.

By using Petroleu, creating an account, accessing the software, contacting our support team, or using any related service provided by Digital Softs, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, you should not use Petroleu or any related services.

For any privacy-related questions, account support, or data requests, users may contact Digital Softs through the contact details provided in this Privacy Policy. The original policy already identifies Digital Softs as the developer/data controller of Petroleu and includes the official website, support emails, phone number, and business address.
